page.overview:
Who is Morwena Hreg?

Morwena Hreg was the mother of Moreg Hreg and the grandmother of Nessa Hreg.

Morwena Hreg was in The Salusan Bull with Ilith Richese and Orilis Io when she was approached by the Prisoner. She was appalled at them for speaking to her and order them to avert their gaze, threatening to have them flogged. She complained that Justis Clagg was deploying idiots to harass her. She recalled her daughter Moreg walking her granddaughter Nessa down the aisle on her wedding, only for Moreg to disintegrate as Nessa was reading her wedding vows due to the "bad spice" epidemic. She believed the Fremen to be responsible and murdered her beloved handmaiden Farnoosh, who claimed distant Fremen ancestry.
